text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is timeless.
MassProductDesign(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignByZahaHadid(x) ::: x is a design by Zaha Hadid.
DesignByKellyWearstler(x) ::: x is a design by Kelly Wearstler.
DesignByMax(x) ::: x is a design by Max.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
Premises:
∀x (DesignByZahaHadid(x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProductDesign(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
∀x (DesignByZahaHadid(x) ⊕ DesignByKellyWearstler(x)) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignByKellyWearstler(x) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignByKellyWearstler(x) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
∀x ((DesignByMax(x) ∧ Timeless(x)) → (MassProductDesign(x) ∧ Evocative(x))) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
∀x (DesignByMax(x) → (Evocative(x) ∨ Dreamy(x))) ::: A design by Max is either evocative or dreamy.
